patterns.note: A rich, deep maroon (almost burgundy) is used as the primary brand color for backgrounds and overlays, creating a warm and luxurious foundation.
The site contrasts a bold, modern sans-serif for prominent headings and body text with an elegant, handwritten script font for the brand logo and decorative section titles.
Sections frequently employ a split-screen layout, pairing high-quality product photography with concise text blocks, often with a dark overlay for text contrast.
The hero section dynamically shrinks on scroll, transitioning the top navigation into a sticky header with a solid background, while subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in effect.

technique_notes: Implement a responsive hero section that uses a video background and dynamically reduces its height on scroll, simultaneously transforming the top navigation into a fixed, opaque header.
Utilize CSS keyframe animations to progressively reveal content sections and individual elements (like product cards) with a staggered fade-up or slide-in motion as they enter the user's viewport.
Establish a strong brand presence through a dominant deep red color palette, using it for full-bleed backgrounds and translucent overlays to enhance product photography and ensure text readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for impact, complemented by smaller, often uppercase labels and an elegant script for decorative titles.
design_tokens.radius: subtle, used on buttons, image corners, and interactive elements like the map container.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous padding in the hero section and good separation between content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a rich, deep maroon combined with a playful, elegant script font and high-quality, warm food photography creates a luxurious yet approachable brand identity. It avoids a sterile, minimal feel by embracing a strong color palette and expressive typography, making the product feel premium and inviting.
